content: {"paper_id":"lab-6a0a4e2737ec","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"label-distribution-learning","exact_quote":"Label Distribution Learning (LDL) is a novel machine learning paradigm","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要开篇明确以标签分布学习为研究任务，并围绕标签模糊性建模。"},{"keyword_id":"data-imputation-recovery","exact_quote":"Tail-Aware Reconstruction of Incomplete Label Distributions","evidence_field":"title","reason_zh":"标题直接表明任务是从不完整标签分布中重建/恢复完整数据。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"However, obtaining complete label distributions in real-world scenarios is challenging, which has led to the emergence of Incomplete Label Distribution Learning (InLDL).","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"不完整标签分布提供了不完整的监督信号，且该设定是论文的核心研究问题。"},{"keyword_id":"class-imbalance","exact_quote":"the sum of the description degrees for normal labels is significantly larger than that for tail labels","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"明确指出现实标签分布数据集中头部与尾部标签描述度总量严重不均衡，并针对长尾不平衡建模。"},{"keyword_id":"low-rank-modeling","exact_quote":"a low-rank component for frequent labels","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"方法显式将恢复的标签分布矩阵分解出低秩成分，用于建模频繁标签的低秩结构。"},{"keyword_id":"sparse-representation","exact_quote":"a sparse component for tail labels","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"方法显式使用稀疏成分表示尾部标签，构成稀疏建模机制。"},{"keyword_id":"label-correlation-modeling","exact_quote":"which makes the use of low-rank label correlations more reasonable for InLDL","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文显式利用低秩标签相关性来恢复标签分布，建模标签间依赖结构。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
